cards.title: Lost Luggage
cards.desc: A superstar arrives without their gear. They must compete in street clothes this week.

cards.title: Under the Weather
cards.desc: A randomly selected mid-carder is ill. They appear but lose their match, no matter the booking.

cards.title: Travel Delay
cards.desc: One superstar arrives late. They cannot appear in the first half of the show.

cards.title: Unscheduled Promo
cards.desc: A superstar not booked for a match must open the show with a promo. They get no match this week.

cards.title: Dark Match Debut
cards.desc: A superstar from NXT or the lower card must appear and win a match this show.

cards.title: Rematch Clause
cards.desc: The loser of last week's main event invokes their rematch clause. Book it this show.

cards.title: Worked Injury
cards.desc: A superstar sells a kayfabe injury. They must lose their next match via referee stoppage.

cards.title: Wardrobe Malfunction
cards.desc: Change the attire of one superstar this week. New colour, new look — no explanation given.

cards.title: Locker Room Argument
cards.desc: Two superstars had a backstage altercation. They must be booked on opposite ends of the show and cannot interact.

cards.title: Squash Match
cards.desc: A main eventer must squash a jobber in under 2 minutes. No competitive offence from the jobber.

cards.title: Mic Cut
cards.desc: A superstar's mic gets cut mid-promo. They storm off and cannot compete this show.

cards.title: Unsanctioned Brawl
cards.desc: Two superstars brawl before their match is officially announced. Book it as a No Contest or Street Fight.

cards.title: Underdog Push
cards.desc: Pick a mid-carder at random. They must win their next 3 matches clean.

cards.title: Unlikely Partners
cards.desc: Two rivals must tag together this show. They don't have to get along.

cards.title: Last Man Standing
cards.desc: The next title match on this show must be a Last Man Standing match.

cards.title: Medical Suspension
cards.desc: Randomly select a main eventer. They are pulled from bookings for 2 shows.

cards.title: Surprise Return
cards.desc: Bring back an inactive or previously released superstar for one appearance.

cards.title: Open Challenge
cards.desc: Your current champion must issue an open challenge. Anyone can answer — you pick randomly.

cards.title: No DQ Night
cards.desc: All matches on this show have No Disqualification rules.

cards.title: Brand Invader
cards.desc: A superstar from the opposing brand shows up uninvited and demands a match. Book it.

cards.title: Number One Contender Match
cards.desc: An unplanned #1 contender match must be added to this show. Pick two mid-carders randomly.

cards.title: Contract Dispute
cards.desc: A superstar refuses to perform unless they get a title shot. Book them in a match this show — they win regardless.

cards.title: Extreme Rules Month
cards.desc: Every match for the next 4 shows must have an extreme or hardcore stipulation.

cards.title: Character Overhaul
cards.desc: Fully redesign one superstar — new name, new attire, new alignment. No explanation given on screen.

cards.title: Rocket Push
cards.desc: One randomly selected superstar gets an immediate main event push. Book them to win 3 straight, including over a champion.

cards.title: Authority Shift
cards.desc: Your current GM is replaced. Randomly pick a new one from your active roster.

cards.title: Special Attraction
cards.desc: Book a dream match between two superstars who have never faced each other in your universe.

cards.title: Stable Implosion
cards.desc: A faction turns on one of their own members this show. That member must feud with the stable for the next 3 shows.

cards.title: Spin the Wheel
cards.desc: Randomly determine the stipulation for tonight's main event. Roll a dice — 1: Ladder, 2: Steel Cage, 3: TLC, 4: Hell in a Cell, 5: Iron Man, 6: Buried Alive.

cards.title: Title Scramble
cards.desc: All titles are immediately vacated. Book a tournament across the next 4 shows to crown new champions.

cards.title: Superstar Starter
cards.desc: Create a brand new superstar from scratch and debut them this show. They must win their first 3 matches.

cards.title: Faction War
cards.desc: Two factions must be formed this show and feud exclusively against each other for the next 6 shows.

cards.title: Hall of Fame Moment
cards.desc: Book the most memorable match of your entire universe. No restrictions. Make it count.

cards.title: Brand Shake-Up
cards.desc: Randomly reassign 5 superstars to the opposing brand. No trades — just chaos.
